meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打造有辨识度的界面视觉风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计新界面或优化现有视觉风格
copy.tagline_en: Craft distinctive visual styles for your UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing a new UI or refining an existing visual style

howto.what: Claude 会像设计主创一样给出有辨识度的界面视觉方案:先制定包含配色、字体、布局和标志性元素的紧凑计划,自查剔除模板化选择后再写代码;界面文案也从用户视角撰写。
howto.when: 当你要新建界面或重构现有界面,或提出视觉方向、排版等改版需求时触发,比如“帮我设计一个页面”“给这个界面做改版”。

say.text: 帮我设计一个植物养护 App 的主页,要独特视觉风格,别用模板感。
say.note: Claude 会先出设计方案再写代码。

say.text: 给这个落地页做改版,先给配色、字体、布局方案再写代码。
say.note: 它会先对照通用模板自查方案再实现。

say.text: 设计一个数据分析仪表盘,并写一段面向用户的界面文案。
say.note: 文案会从最终用户视角、用平实语言写。

howto.what_en: Claude drafts a compact design plan (palette, typefaces, layout, signature), checks it against generic template looks, revises default choices, then builds the UI from it. Interface copy is written from the end user's perspective.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to build new UI or reshape an existing one, or requests a visual direction/redesign—e.g. 'design me a page' or 'rework this interface'.

say_en.text: Design a plant-care app homepage with a distinctive look, no template feel.
say_en.note: Claude produces a design plan first, then code.

say_en.text: Rework this landing page: give palette, type, and layout before code.
say_en.note: It checks the plan against generic defaults first.

say_en.text: Design a data dashboard and write user-facing interface copy.
say_en.note: Copy is written in plain, user-facing language.
